Catholic Traditionalists Ordain Bishops, Defying Pope Leo

A breakaway group of ultra-conservative Catholics, the Society of Saint Pius X, has ordained four bishops without the consent of Pope Leo. This act of defiance, described by the group as a "sacred duty," has led to automatic excommunication for the bishops and raised fears of a schism within the Catholic Church. Thousands of worshippers attended the consecration ceremony held in the Swiss Alps.
